|Comments=Road: The beginning of the dirt road has a pretty deep dip, but it wasn't bad after getting past it.

Water levels are low compared to the spring, but still a fun run. Each of us wore a different combination of thermal insulation: one wore a 3mm wetsuit; another no wetsuit but had rain pants and a rain jacket; I was comfortable in 3mm and a light rain jacket (I run cold). The norm spots were breezy and chilly, R4 to R5. 

R1: Bolt is slightly loose

R2: Bowl is still over waist deep

R3: Bowl is shallow, transition to R4 is straightforward

R4 & R5: Webbing is good

Lots of mosquitoes out on the hike in and out.
